title: Grays rescued orphaned Chinese children and want to return them to humans

tellings.quote: They were young Chinese people that the grace had rescued, not abducted, but they they had been orphaned and the grace had refued.

plain: Charles Hall, who says he spent three years in the 1960s among non-human beings in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada, near Area 51, tells Michels that he saw young Chinese people living with beings he calls Grays. According to Hall, the beings had not abducted them but "rescued" them after they were orphaned, and they want to return them to human society one day. He tells it as something he saw himself, and it would mean such beings take people in out of care, not for experiments.
